heroTitleLine2: Quality Assurance in the Oven Process
heroSub: At Phinia's Izmir ESBAS facility, the post-coating oven process was made fully traceable through basket and batch based tracking.
contextTitle: End-to-end control for post-coating oven operations
contextP1: Phinia's manufacturing facility in the Izmir ESBAS Free Zone serves the automotive industry.
contextP2: In this project, products were tracked at basket and batch level to ensure traceability and control of critical oven process parameters after coating.
problemTitle: Quality risks in oven entry and process parameter control
problemLede: After coating, products had to enter the oven only under approved conditions while critical process parameters were continuously monitored. Uncontrolled entry conditions and process variables created quality risk.

problemList.text: Products had to be validated by elapsed time and coating OK/NOK status before oven entry.
Full traceability was required at individual product, bar-basket, and batch levels.

solutionTitle: Basket-batch association with real-time oven parameter monitoring
solutionLede: At oven entry, basket loading preparation established new batch association. Entry conditions were validated, and critical parameters such as door opening, door-open duration, curing time, and ramp-up to curing temperature were monitored and controlled.

steps.title: Basket and Batch Preparation
steps.text: Products are prepared in baskets and associated with a new batch at oven entry.

steps.title: Entry Condition Validation
steps.text: Elapsed time and coating OK/NOK conditions are checked before products enter the oven.

steps.title: Process Parameter Monitoring
steps.text: Door events, door-open duration, curing time, and curing temperature ramp-up are monitored.

steps.title: Unit-Level Reporting
steps.text: Traceability records and reports are generated for individual product, bar-basket, and batch units.

techTitle: C# SCADA, OPC-UA, barcode scanners, and PLC monitoring

techGrid.title: C# SCADA Application
techGrid.text: Manages basket-batch association, process condition validation, and reporting.

techGrid.title: OPC-UA Protocol
techGrid.text: Provides reliable real-time communication between SCADA and PLC.

techGrid.title: Barcode Scanners
techGrid.text: Capture basket and product identity data for process initiation and tracking.

techGrid.title: PLC-Based Process Monitoring
techGrid.text: Monitors oven entry conditions and critical parameters including door, time, and temperature values.

integrationTitle: Central process management with OPC-UA and Oracle
integrationDesc: The system integrates directly with shop-floor PLC via OPC-UA and with enterprise systems via Oracle. Basket-batch, oven entry conditions, and process parameter data are collected from the line, while traceability and reporting data are shared centrally in Oracle.

integrationList.text: Basket, batch, entry conditions, and oven parameters are monitored in real time.
Traceability records and unit-level reports are shared at enterprise level.

resultsTitle: Quality assurance and auditable oven process

resultsGrid.title: Condition-Based Entry Control
resultsGrid.text: Only compliant products enter the process through elapsed-time and coating OK/NOK validation.

resultsGrid.title: Critical Parameter Visibility
resultsGrid.text: Continuous monitoring of door, curing duration, and temperature strengthened quality assurance.

resultsGrid.title: Complete Traceability
resultsGrid.text: Individual product, bar-basket, and batch tracking with unit-level reporting enabled full auditability.
